description: Trigger a Meltano Cloud pipeline run via REST API — fire-and-forget or wait for completion.

pipeline_id.label: Pipeline ID
pipeline_id.description: Meltano Cloud pipeline UUID to run (see `meltano cloud pipeline list` or the Cloud UI)

api_token_env.label: API Token Env Var
api_token_env.description: Env var holding the Meltano Cloud API bearer token (create one via the Cloud UI's API Keys page or POST /api/apikeys)

wait_for_completion.label: Wait For Completion
wait_for_completion.description: Poll the triggered job until COMPLETE/ERROR/STOPPED

poll_interval_seconds.label: Poll Interval Seconds
poll_interval_seconds.description: Seconds between polls when wait_for_completion is true

timeout_seconds.label: Timeout Seconds
timeout_seconds.description: Max seconds to wait before giving up

cancel_on_timeout.label: Cancel On Timeout
cancel_on_timeout.description: If the timeout is reached, PUT /jobs/{job-id}/stopped to cancel the still-running Meltano Cloud job before raising
